parameters.name: NeighborDeviceId
parameters.description: 1905 AL MAC Address of the Neighbor.

parameters.name: IEEE1905DeviceRef
parameters.description: The value in this parameter is a reference to the 1905 device in the {{object|###.AL}} table, provided backhaul connectivity by this device. This can be used to construct a network topology from this 1905 device. Since the IEEE 1905.1 protocol forms a tree topology, there is one and only one path to the gateway for each 1905 Device, but each parent can support multiple child connections. {{reference}}

parameters.name: IEEE802dot1Bridge
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not there is at least one IEEE 802.1 bridge between this device and the neighbor. If {{false}}, no IEEE 802.1 bridge exists between this device and the neighbor. If {{true}}, there is at least one IEEE 802.1 bridge exists between this device and the neighbor.

object.description: This object represents an instance of an {{object}} for the {{object|###.AL}}. These values are from the Topology response message as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-15: 1905 neighbor device TLV}}.
